titleStmt.title: Viterbi Decoding Algorithm for Hidden Markov Models in Speech Recognition

div.head: 1. Introduction
div.p: Hidden Markov Models provide probabilistic foundations for sequential speech analysis.

div.head: 2. Mathematical Preliminaries
div.p: Probability distributions and Dynamic Programming form the basis.

div.head: 3. Detection via Viterbi Algorithm
div.p: The Viterbi Algorithm finds the maximum a posteriori state sequence.

div.head: 4. Proposed Methodology
div.p: We propose Adaptive Viterbi Decoding for high-noise acoustic environments.
